answer: At dawn, validators commit bonded collateral in separate escrows, while a trellis of signed attestations lets the protocol link coordinated identities. If k identities equivocate together, their joint penalty scales as O(k²), preventing stake from being safely divided among sybils. On detection, an exponential multiplier increases swarm-wide capital loss, and asymmetric depreciation prevents slashed collateral from recovering its value; the nectar of cheap identity creation is thus offset by correlated risk.
